titulo: This rugged phone’s removable camera can survive and capture your extreme adventures
cuerpo: RugOne's Xsnap 7 Pro comes with both an IP68 and IP69K rating, meaning the rugged phone can survive intense water blasts and complete submersion for up to 30 minutes.
